title: extcap: add search bar to multiselect
description:
This PR adds a search bar to the "multiselect" UI in extcap. With many elements, it's very, very useful.

![image](/uploads/4236a529844815bd00ce2ffea2c8b1e3/image.png){width=302 height=265}

notes.body: changed the description

added 1 commit
  • 2220407e - extcap: add search bar to multiselect
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23132/diffs?diff_id=1621040785&start_sha=58d551b8622deac3a0c1fdd7a518f48608fe89df)
changed the description
You should not need to delete tableProxyModel if it is parented with this object.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23132/diffs?diff_id=1621927449&start_sha=2220407eab2b48c49b77d923610fe4c2d0309efc#93e9a520eb938fee751dfddc4cf68bc3c6a726db_46_39)
You don't need the `setLayout` call, `layout` is already set as the top level layout for pane by passing `pane` to the `QVBoxLayout` constructor.
The `addLayout` calls below transfers ownership of `treeView` and `searchBox`, and it is the layout's responsibility to delete them, so the `delete searchBox` and `delete treeView` are unnecessary.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23132/diffs?diff_id=1621927449&start_sha=2220407eab2b48c49b77d923610fe4c2d0309efc#93e9a520eb938fee751dfddc4cf68bc3c6a726db_43_39)
The viewModel can be parented with this object, in which case it would not need to be deleted in the destructor.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23132/diffs?diff_id=1621927449&start_sha=2220407eab2b48c49b77d923610fe4c2d0309efc#93e9a520eb938fee751dfddc4cf68bc3c6a726db_139_131)
It's not clear to me that the layout or searchBox need to be private members exposed in the header if they're parented appropriately.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/23132/diffs?diff_id=1621927449&start_sha=2220407eab2b48c49b77d923610fe4c2d0309efc#73a55b48fd5e20fea5f256a652ac836259ba7415_69_68)
You are right.
